request-only.scope: Diagnostic default request-only mode of the same compiled fixture:4096 requests, no composed multi-shot/mailbox/explicit-GC branch. This is not the main acceptance workload or a replacement for its sixteen successful executions. Reuse exact old/current modules; p1 only, original30/300s bounds, no heap or waiting change.
request-only.publication: Fresh inode, exact digest, same leased source/cwd, no per-sample compiler invocation.

factor-controls.sourceText:
(define probe-mode (cadr (command-line)))
(define probe-a 0)
(define probe-b 0)
(define (probe-body)
  (cond ((string=? probe-mode "--globals")
         (let loop ((i 0))
           (if (##fx= i 4096) (##fx+ probe-a probe-b)
               (begin (set! probe-a (##fx+ probe-a 1))
                      (set! probe-b (##fx+ probe-b 1))
                      (loop (##fx+ i 1))))))
        ((string=? probe-mode "--loop")
         (let loop ((i 0) (a 0) (b 0))
           (if (##fx= i 4096) (##fx+ a b)
               (loop (##fx+ i 1) (##fx+ a 1) (##fx+ b 1)))))
        ((string=? probe-mode "--gc") (##gc) 'gc-only)
        (else 'noop)))
(write (cons 'COST-FACTOR (##exec-stats probe-body)))
(newline)
factor-controls.scope: P1 factor controls, not the composed acceptance population: fixed local loop, equal-count globals, one explicit GC, no-op. Exact role SDKs; original30/300s limits; no heap, affinity or waiting change.
factor-controls.publication: Fresh inode, exact digest, same leased source/cwd, no per-sample compiler invocation.

allocationCounter.reason: Candidate request-only reports negative bytes-allocated after GC even at p1. Composed p1 raw +916504 is not a qualified physical allocation or VM-total delta; p2 migration also changes local carrier counter ownership.
allocationCounter.next: Refine one accounting owner and GC/context rebase law; no clamping or peak-memory claim.

proven: In-place signed module overwrite caused kernel invalid-page SIGKILL for PID78016; fresh-inode replay completed56 executions without this failure.
Request record payload grows2 to6words:4 extra words/request,32 bytes/request on this64bit host,131072 requested payload bytes/4096 requests.
supported: Explicit request claim/state/completion and owner graph introduce work in the hot path.
Request-only regression persists with no composed continuation/mailbox branch, so that branch alone is not its cause.
unresolved: No same-native-code ablation separates runtime authority from compiler/lowering and other candidate changes. Loop and GC controls also change; do not attribute every lost millisecond to request state.
Small samples and p2 route differences prohibit a universal throughput coefficient.
No physical whole-round peak or matched whole cold Gerbil build measurement.
